mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.colors.title: The Five Leylines (WUBRG)
mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.colors.summary: Understanding White, Blue, Black, Red, Green, and Colorless mana.
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.colors_1.title: White & Blue Leylines
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.colors_1.body: {W} White draws from sunlit plains and represents protection and divine order. {U} Blue flows from oceans and rivers, governing intellect, counter-magic, and deceit.
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.colors_2.title: Black, Red & Green Leylines
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.colors_2.body: {B} Black leylines thrive in murky swamps, seeking power at any price. {R} Red burns in rugged peaks, unleashing explosive fury. {G} Green pulses in ancient forests, nurturing boundless vitality.
mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.regen.title: Biome Mana Regeneration
mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.regen.summary: How surrounding Minecraft biomes generate mana over time.
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.regen_1.title: Natural Leyline Pulses
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.regen_1.body: Standing in a biome harmonizes your spark with its matching mana color every 100 ticks (5 seconds). Absent colors begin natural decay every 200 ticks (10 seconds).
mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.upgrades.title: Expanding Your Mana Cap
mtg.guidebook.entry.mana.upgrades.summar: Investing experience points into maximum mana capacity.
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.upgrades_1.title: Attuning Your Spark
mtg.guidebook.page.mana.upgrades_1.body: Planeswalkers begin with a maximum mana cap of 20. Spend vanilla Minecraft XP levels to permanently expand your pool by +5 up to the hard cap of 100 mana.
mtg.guidebook.entry.cards.types.title: The Five Card Types
mtg.guidebook.entry.cards.types.summary: Lands, Instants, Sorceries, Enchantments, and Creatures.
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.types_1.title: Lands, Instants & Sorceries
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.types_1.body: Lands provide mana and trigger Landfall. Instants cast with zero windup for immediate reflexes. Sorceries require channeling scaled to mana value.
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.types_2.title: Enchantments & Invocations
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.types_2.body: Enchantments manifest lingering planar auras. Creature cards invoke loyal companions aligned with your spark to fight by your side.
mtg.guidebook.entry.cards.delays.title: Casting Delays & Channeling
mtg.guidebook.entry.cards.delays.summary: Understanding windup timers, cooldowns, and damage interruptions.
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.delays_1.title: Windup & Cooldown Mechanics
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.delays_1.body: Sorceries channel for 10 ticks (0.5s) per mana value. Lands incur a 60-second recharge delay. Instants feature brief tactical cooldowns.
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.delays_2.title: Channel Interruption
mtg.guidebook.page.cards.delays_2.body: Suffering 2.0 or more damage (1 heart) while channeling interrupts the spell, cancels casting, and incurs a 20-tick penalty cooldown.
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.hand.title: The Dedicated Hand Dock
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.hand.summary: How the dedicated card hand functions separately from inventory.
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.hand_1.title: Spellcaster Dock
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.hand_1.body: Your dedicated card hand is decoupled from vanilla hotbars, allowing spellcasting without occupying inventory or equipment slots.
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.slots.title: Slot State Machine
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.slots.summary: EMPTY, READY, WINDUP, COOLDOWN, and LOCKED states.
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.slots_1.title: Hand Slot States
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.slots_1.body: Slots cycle through READY to cast, WINDUP while channeling, and COOLDOWN while recharging before becoming READY again.
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.capacity.title: Hand Capacity Upgrades
mtg.guidebook.entry.deck.capacity.summar: Expanding hand capacity from 4 up to 7 cards.
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.capacity_1.title: Capacity Expansion
mtg.guidebook.page.deck.capacity_1.body: Unlock slot 5 for 10 XP levels, slot 6 for 15 levels, and slot 7 for 23 levels, granting unmatched tactical versatility in battle.
mtg.guidebook.entry.progression.acquisit: Unlocking cards via mining, farming, mob drops, and dungeons.
mtg.guidebook.page.progression.acquisiti: Mine valuable ores, harvest mature crops, defeat hostile monsters, and search dungeon chests to unlock permanent cards in your collection.
mtg.guidebook.entry.progression.wildcard: How excess duplicates convert into higher-rarity wildcards.
mtg.guidebook.page.progression.wildcards: Collecting 4 duplicate Commons converts into 1 Uncommon Wildcard. 4 Uncommons yield 1 Rare Wildcard. 4 Rares yield 1 Mythic Wildcard.
Redeem wildcards in your spellbook to permanently unlock any known card of matching rarity with 100% deterministic success.
mtg.guidebook.entry.invocations.stats.su: Converting MTG P/T stats into Minecraft health and damage.
mtg.guidebook.page.invocations.stats_1.b: 1 Toughness converts to 4 HP (2 hearts). 1 Power converts to 2 Attack Damage (1 heart). A 4/4 creature enters with 16 HP and deals 8 damage per hit.
mtg.guidebook.entry.invocations.ai.title: Companion AI & Leash
mtg.guidebook.entry.invocations.ai.summa: Defending, auto-guarding, and emergency leash teleportation.
mtg.guidebook.page.invocations.ai_1.body: Summoned creatures defend their owner, attack targeted foes, and cannot be harmed by friendly spells or allied invocations.
mtg.guidebook.page.invocations.ai_2.body: If separated by more than 48 blocks, invocations instantly teleport back to your side. Right-click creatures with {T} abilities to generate mana.
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.nodes.title: Elemental Mana Nodes
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.nodes.summary: Finding and tapping natural mana concentrations.
mtg.guidebook.page.world.nodes_1.title: Node Attunement & Charges
mtg.guidebook.page.world.nodes_1.body: Elemental Mana Nodes spawn naturally across biomes. Each node holds up to 5 charges, recharging every 200 ticks (10s). Attuning grants +3 colored mana.
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.altars.title: Planeswalker Altars & Rituals
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.altars.summary: Ancient ritual structures spaced across the landscape.
mtg.guidebook.page.world.altars_1.title: Altar Structures
mtg.guidebook.page.world.altars_1.body: Planeswalker Altars generate with 32-chunk spacing and 8-chunk separation. Performing rituals requires placing offerings and channeling for 60 ticks (3s).
mtg.guidebook.page.world.altars_2.title: Ritual Types & Rewards
mtg.guidebook.page.world.altars_2.body: Offer 1 Mana Gem to replenish your colored mana. Offer all 5 gems for Planar Conflux (+5 overcharge & a Rare Wildcard). Offer a gem with 10 XP to summon a World Boss.
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.bosses.title: Mythic World Boss Encounters
mtg.guidebook.entry.world.bosses.summary: Tactics against Shivan Dragon, Demon of Death's Gate, and more.
mtg.guidebook.page.world.bosses_1.title: Shivan Dragon & Demon of Death's Gate
mtg.guidebook.page.world.bosses_1.body: Shivan Dragon strafes from above with fireballs before descending in enraged fury. Demon of Death's Gate tramples foes and siphons life to heal itself.
mtg.guidebook.page.world.bosses_2.title: Serra Avatar & Phyrexian Obliterator
mtg.guidebook.page.world.bosses_2.body: Serra Avatar's power scales with health and casts Wrath of God. Phyrexian Obliterator unleashes horrific 50% damage recoil and poison upon its attackers.
